title: The Giant Jack-o'-Lantern
seo_title: Giant Jack-o'-Lantern Charcuterie Board: Plan & Shopping List
description: A giant jack-o'-lantern charcuterie board for 12 to 15: a pumpkin of orange cheddar and apricots, soppressata ribs and a grinning face of olives and blackberries.
hook: A grinning pumpkin as big as the table.
board_size: 36 to 40 in round board or a black slate round

items.name: Dry Spanish chorizo or hot salami

why: The face is the trick, and it's just black food: black olives and blackberries filling two triangle eyes, a nose and a jagged grin. Against the bright orange around them (cheddar, Colby, Muenster and dried apricots), they read instantly as carved holes.
Soppressata lines the pumpkin's ribs and chorizo and pepperoni make a darker outer ring. It's the Halloween board that gets photographed.

timeline.what: Cut all the cheese cubes, slice the soppressata and peel the clementines if you like.
Lay the pretzel outline, the ribs and the face.
Fill the ribs and the face, then the outer ring.
Add the stem bundle and the rosemary vine.

faq.q: How do you make a jack-o'-lantern charcuterie board?
faq.a: Fill a big circle with orange cheese and apricots, mark the ribs with soppressata, and fill the eyes, nose and grin with black olives and blackberries.

faq.q: How many people does it feed?
faq.a: 12 to 15 as the main party food.

Cube the cheese the day before. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
